Alyssa Chen: Ok — PolarisGrid asked us to run a joint perf/W + throughput sweep next week. Proposed scope: small/med/large sequence lengths, 3 batch sizes, and two kernel tuning configs (pol-v1, pol-v2). Need instrumented power telemetry, reproducible harness, and canonical prompt set. Tentative window: Mon–Wed 09:00–17:00 UTC. Can eng/runtime own kernel toggle + patch application?

Diego Marquez: I can own kernel toggles and the patch branches. For PolarisGrid SoC we should flip L2 prefetch + disable XLA tiling for the second profile. I'll push branch `polarisgrid/kernel-tune` and produce a docker image with `/opt/bench`. Quick power sampling hints: for NVML GPUs `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 10` (10s samples), for partner PMBus devices use their pmu tool: `pmu_power_read --interval 1s`.

Keisha O'Neill: I'll reserve testbeds: `testbed-pol-1` (internal), and coordinate access to `polarisgrid-remote` (partner lab). Upload target harness to `s3://redwood-partnerships/polarisgrid/bench-v3/`. Can we standardize CSV schema? I suggest header: 
```
run_id,model,seq_len,batch,tokens_per_sec,avg_power_w,perf_per_w,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,kernel_tag,notes
```
Also include SHA of kernel and container. We'll need a small eval to ensure no quality regressions — run 200 prompts from the partner prompt set.

Alyssa Chen: Perfect. Add these tags to all artifacts: `partner=polarisgrid`, `run=perfW-v1`, `kernel=pol-v1`. Please create a Jira and add results to the runbook at `/docs/partnerships/polarisgrid-perf-w-playbook.md`. Who will own the analysis and summary for the marketplace brief?

Diego Marquez: I'll do the first-pass analysis and produce a short summary slide. Proposed acceptance rule: if perf_per_w improves >=5% with <=10% latency regression we consider promoting; if perf_per_w improves <5% and latency regresses >10% we reject. Watch for KV-cache misses and memory growth (OOM risk).

InfraBot: Calendar invite created: "PolarisGrid joint bench" — Mon 09:00 UTC (3 sessions). Jira ticket created: PRJ-1428. Artifacts dir: `s3://redwood-partnerships/polarisgrid/bench-v3/`

Keisha O'Neill: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate partner ops for power-meter hookups and remote access. Need PolarisGrid to run a smoke: `./run_bench.sh --model gpt-small --seq 512 --batch 8 --power-sample 1s` and upload `logs/` and `pm_bus/*.csv` to the S3 path. Also ask them to share kernel vmlinuz and dmesg if they hit warnings.

SRE-Bot: NOTE: Please ensure SSH bastion keys are added to `vault/partnerships/polarisgrid/keys` before remote runs. Automated attenuation policy will snapshot telemetry to `prometheus-partner/polarisgrid/` and store metrics in influx for dashboarding.

Alyssa Chen: Thanks all — tagging PolarisGrid contacts in a follow-up DM (cc @matt_p). We'll iterate the runbook tomorrow after Diego's branch is up.
